sodam-119: How are Sodam and FDAM related?
sodam-120: FDAM is the AI operations platform used by franchisor headquarters, and Sodam is the store app connected to the same data. HQ manages all-store status and operations in FDAM, while stores handle ordering, inventory, communication, and staff tasks in Sodam.
sodam-121: Does the AI place orders automatically?
sodam-122: No. By default, Sodam first shows the recommended order calculated by FDAM's AI, and the store owner reviews and adjusts it to reflect conditions on the ground before placing the final order.
sodam-123: Can I use it on my phone?
sodam-124: Sodam is designed so stores can easily check frequent tasks on mobile. Supported devices and how the app is delivered depend on the scope of your implementation.
sodam-125: Can HQ see store status too?
sodam-126: Yes. Within its access permissions, HQ can view each store's orders, inventory, inquiries, and operations in FDAM and use that to support stores.
sodam-127: Can we migrate data from our current ordering system?
sodam-128: When you adopt Sodam, we review your current system's data formats and what can be exported, then plan how to migrate product, supplier, order, and inventory data.
sodam-130: We'll show you the best way to roll out Sodam based on your current ordering and inventory process and the size of your network.
